title: Farm Scene 4 — Animal Actions Around the Barn
purpose: Describe familiar farm animals, what they are doing, and where they are.

sentenceModels: The cow is by the barn.
The pig is in the mud.
The chickens are pecking the grain.
The sheep is near the fence.

adultSupport.focus: Move from naming the animals to saying what each one is doing and where it is.
expansionPrompts: Can you make a longer sentence about the pig?
Why might the chickens be pecking the ground?

visualAudit: Auto-batch panel reviewed for the described targets.
